_authority: AUTHORED. Every graded Docker call site carries an explicit trust boundary, and every relevant steering mechanism carries an explicit disposition. An unclassified site or mechanism fails closed.
_model_choice: Forced by MEASUREMENT, not preference. This host has no docker CLI, no ~/.docker, no daemon socket, no context store and no Docker Desktop, and the gate forbids installing Docker. Model A requires binding a daemon-reported identity, server version, security options and architecture — none obtainable here, and claiming them would be inventing evidence. Model B claims strictly less and enforces what it claims.
_purpose: Close Gate 4N-I28AP finding ADV-I28AP-01: Docker CLI identity was bound while daemon, context, environment, configuration, transport, plugin and credential state were entirely unadjudicated.
_what_is_not_claimed: the Docker daemon's identity or integrity
that binding the CLI binary binds any of the above

ci_assumption.daemon_provisioned_by: GitHub-hosted Actions runner (ubuntu-latest), with docker preinstalled
ci_assumption.docker_output_is_not_proof: docker-security-check.sh reads its verdict from `docker run` output. Under this assumption that verdict is evidence about the image AS BUILT BY THE ASSUMED DAEMON, and is explicitly not independent cryptographic proof of anything about this repository.
ci_assumption.failure_behaviour: If the assumption does not hold — a forged or partial CI marker, a steering variable set, a context defined, a config field that redirects — the graded run is INVALIDATED before any Docker output is consumed.
not_claimed: that Docker output is independent cryptographic proof about this repository
ci_assumption.statement: The Docker daemon used by every graded Docker call site is provisioned by the GitHub-hosted Actions runner. Its integrity is OUTSIDE repository verification and is assumed. This repository verifies only that no repository-controlled mechanism redirects Docker away from that daemon.

HttpHeaders.why: extra headers on API calls to the ALREADY-selected daemon; it cannot change which daemon that is

aliases.why: CLI subcommand aliases; they expand to docker subcommands whose argv this gate scans for steering flags

auths.why: embedded registry credentials change which registry a push or pull authenticates to

cliPluginsExtraDirs.why: it adds directories from which the CLI loads plugin executables

credHelpers.why: per-registry helper binaries, executed by the CLI, with the same injection surface

credsStore.why: it names an external helper binary the CLI executes to obtain registry credentials

currentContext.why: it selects a context, and therefore a daemon endpoint, without any environment variable being set

detachKeys.why: a key sequence for detaching from an interactive container; it cannot select a daemon, a registry or a helper

experimental.why: it enables command behaviour outside the adjudicated set

features.why: CLI feature toggles that do not select an endpoint, helper or registry

imagesFormat.why: output formatting for `docker images`; presentation only

plugins.why: plugin configuration can alter subcommand behaviour

proxies.why: it injects proxy environment into every container the CLI starts

psFormat.why: output formatting for `docker ps`; presentation only

stackOrchestrator.why: retired swarm/kubernetes stack selector; no declared call site uses `docker stack`

statsFormat.why: output formatting for `docker stats`; presentation only

BUILDKIT_HOST.why: it moves the BuildKit worker that actually performs builds to an attacker-chosen endpoint

COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD.why: it changes which client performs compose builds

DOCKER_API_VERSION.why: pinning an old API version can change command semantics and silently disable newer safety behaviour

DOCKER_BUILDKIT.why: it switches the builder implementation, changing which component interprets the Dockerfile

DOCKER_CERT_PATH.why: it supplies the client certificates used to reach a TLS daemon

DOCKER_CONFIG.why: it relocates the config directory, and with it currentContext, credential helpers and plugin directories

DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST.why: it changes whether image signatures are enforced, altering what a pull or push accepts

DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST_SERVER.why: it redirects the notary server that content trust consults

DOCKER_CONTEXT.why: it selects a named context, which carries its own daemon endpoint and TLS material

DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM.why: it changes the image platform actually built and run, so the artifact verified is not the artifact shipped

DOCKER_HOST.why: it selects the daemon endpoint outright — the single most direct redirection

DOCKER_TLS.why: it changes transport security for the daemon connection

DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY.why: setting it to 0 disables verification of the daemon this gate does not otherwise identify

HTTP_PROXY.why: runner egress configuration is part of the assumed CI environment; it cannot select a different daemon

SSH_AUTH_SOCK.why: no declared call site uses an ssh:// context; with DOCKER_HOST and DOCKER_CONTEXT both FATAL_IF_PRESENT there is no path by which an SSH transport is selected

XDG_CONFIG_HOME.why: the docker CLI resolves its config from DOCKER_CONFIG or ~/.docker, not XDG paths
